summary: V4.4 Phase E (iter18) — PDF polish + Profile byline. Backend pytest 13/13 PASS in 2.5s for new iter18 suite. Cumulative regression across iter9+11+12+13+14+15+16+18 = 136 PASS / 1 FAIL (the single fail is a stale exact-list assertion in test_refactor_iter11::test_openapi_has_expected_tags_and_ops — pre-existing since iter11 and unrelated to iter18). All 6 PDF polish issues from the user are resolved end-to-end and verified via pypdf text extraction: cover uses BESM 4E logo, 'Evereantha — The Maiden Adventure' centered, 'by Fran Pietrowski' + 'Weaved in TableGnostic' + © 2026 + Dyskami required-attribution paragraph; chapter pages render single 'CHAPTER  I' heading (no duplicate Arabic-numeral repeat); body pages have multi-paragraph speaker-turn breaks; legal page renders 'Publisher's Required Attribution' callout + clean Compliance Summary (no markdown markers); footer reads 'Weaved in TableGnostic · by Fran Pietrowski · p. N'. Profile byline persists via PATCH /api/auth/me (set/clear/empty-body-noop all behave correctly). Frontend popover smoke-verified on live preview: Export PDF → atelier-export-pdf-popover with byline-input (prefilled), byline-save (triggered PATCH /auth/me 200), download chronicle button all rendered & wired. Final byline left as 'Fran Pietrowski' for downstream UI testing.

minor.issue: Stale exact-list assertion fails because the app added new routers (atelier, battlemap, channels, reference, ingest) since iter11 was authored. Not a runtime bug — only the test's hardcoded expected list is out of date. Pre-existing, not caused by iter18.

action_items: OPTIONAL — refresh test_refactor_iter11::test_openapi_has_expected_tags_and_ops to use a contains-subset assertion instead of exact-list equality so the suite stays green as new routers are added. Not a blocker for V4.4 sign-off.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pdf_export.py _build_pdf: cover title auto-shrink loop (42→34→28→22→18) is solid — long campaign names like 'Evereantha — The Maiden Adventure' wrap cleanly via a Paragraph with TA_CENTER inside a width-aware (pw - 2*margin - 0.4*inch) box. Title bottom Y is computed from actual wrapped height so subtitle/decorative-rule never collide.

routes/pdf_export.py _session_prose: speaker-change paragraph break is the correct fix for the chat-log digest fallback. Each speaker turn becomes a distinct paragraph in narrative.split('\n\n'), so first-line text-indent (firstLineIndent=18) renders correctly. Verified body pages contain ≥8 line breaks i.e. multi-paragraph layout, not a single wall.

routes/pdf_export.py _legal_required_footer: blockquote-only extraction from LEGAL_COMPLIANCE.md is well-scoped. Stops at next ### system header so it can't bleed into Anime 5E text. Renders the verbatim Dyskami quote inside a callout_bg-filled bordered Paragraph on the legal page — meets publisher requirement.

routes/pdf_export.py _strip_markdown: simple but adequate — strips leading >/*/- bullets, removes ** and `. The Compliance Summary section now reads as clean prose. No raw '**' present in legal page text per pypdf extraction.

routes/pdf_export.py chrome(): footer 'Weaved in TableGnostic · by {gm_byline}' (left) + 'p. N' (right) and header campaign-name + system-name are both drawn via canv.drawString with the correct font/colour. Confirmed in extracted body text.

routes/auth.py PATCH /me: ProfilePatchIn with Optional[byline_name] is correctly handled — empty string clears to None via 'body.byline_name.strip() or None'; empty body skips the $set entirely (no-op). Returns sanitize(fresh) so password_hash never leaks.
core/models.py: UserOut now exposes byline_name. ProfilePatchIn validates max_length=120 — sane. No regression in existing UserOut consumers.

frontend/src/components/AtelierTab.jsx ExportPdfBtn: popover correctly prefills the input from /auth/me byline_name, PATCHes on Save, then triggers GET export.pdf via the saved byline (server-side reads it from db.users — no need to pass query param). Network confirmed: PATCH /auth/me → 200. Good UX: Save and Download are separate so the GM can preview the byline before paying the LLM-free PDF render.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter18 suite (13/13). Cumulative iter9+11+12+13+14+15+16+18 = 99.3% (136/137). The single fail is stale tag-list assertion in iter11, pre-existing.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — Export PDF popover end-to-end verified on the live preview: popover opens, byline input prefilled, Save → PATCH /auth/me 200, Download button rendered.

The iter11 tag-list fail is pre-existing and unrelated. iter18 destructive (calls reset). Frontend popover selectors confirmed live: atelier-export-pdf-btn → atelier-export-pdf-popover containing atelier-export-byline-input + atelier-export-byline-save + atelier-export-pdf-download. PATCH /api/auth/me network call confirmed 200. PDF bytes ~340-440KB depending on chat-log volume; ≥10 pages; cover/chapters/legal all assertable via pypdf text extraction. To re-render the PDF in the UI, log in as GMFran → Evereantha campaign → Atelier tab → Export PDF → Download chronicle.
rca of the issue: Not a bug-fix iteration. The 6 user-reported PDF defects from chronicle.pdf were addressed at routes/pdf_export.py: (1) wrong logo → STYLE_PROFILES['besm-4e'].logo_files now lists besm-4e.png FIRST so /app/frontend/public/system-logos/besm-4e.png takes precedence over the legacy anime5e logo; (2) title not centered/width-aware → cover_page now renders the title through a Paragraph(TA_CENTER) inside a width-aware box with a 5-step font-size auto-shrink ladder; (3) no GM byline → cover_page draws 'by {gm_byline}' below decorative rule + 'Weaved in TableGnostic' italic line, sourced from db.users.byline_name then name; (4) missing Dyskami legal → _legal_required_footer extracts the blockquote verbatim from LEGAL_COMPLIANCE.md and renders both on cover bottom AND in a bordered callout box on the legal page; (5) double 'Chapter N' headers → _emit() now sets title_text = first session's short title (e.g. 'The Maiden Road'); chapter page renders ONE Paragraph(chapter_label='CHAPTER  I') + ONE Paragraph(chapter_title=narrative title) — no duplicated 'Chapter 1' line; (6) no paragraph indentation/separation → _session_prose chat-log fallback now paragraph-breaks on speaker change (joins with \n\n); body style sets firstLineIndent=18; sessions inside a chapter separated by a 50% width HRFlowable accent rule. All fixes confirmed via pypdf.PdfReader text extraction.
